payload.title: Holocene Ice Window Size
payload.description: This workflow analyzes the size of ice windows during the Holocene epoch using paleoclimate data. It involves importing and processing datasets from the LiPD format, focusing on specific indices of interest within each dataset. The workflow employs various data visualization and analysis libraries to explore and visualize the data.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data processing and visualization. Suppress warnings for presentation purposes.
